quest.title: Welcome to the Adventurers' Guild
quest.description: Katheryne from the Adventurers' Guild has sent you an invitation.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x100, Primogem x20, Fine Enhancement Ore x3

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: Welcome to the <color=#00E1FFFF>Adventurers' Guild</color>. Actually, I have had my eye on you for a long time.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #You've had your eye on {NICKNAME}, eh? Has {M#he}{F#she} been causing some mischief?

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: Oh, that is not what I meant at all. Being on the lookout for great adventurers is part of my job.

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: When I look at you, I see one with the potential to rival the great adventurers of legends.

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: Nevertheless, to the adventurer, experience is far more precious than potential.

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: You must accumulate <color=#00E1FFFF>Adventure EXP</color> to increase your <color=#00E1FFFF>Adventure Rank</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: Time is of the essence. Allow me to brief you on—

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait! Are you saying we're like, official adventurers now?

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: Do not worry, the Adventurers' Guild does not charge a membership fee or impose any kind of duties on its members.

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: In short, there are lots of benefits but no drawbacks to becoming a member.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Basically, the Adventurers' Guild rewards you every time your Adventure Rank increases.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Here is a new members' gift for you. You will need to return here to claim rewards in the future.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Haha... New recruits these days certainly do not beat around the bush.

talks.objective: Talk to Katheryne for more details
Talk to Katheryne for more details

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: Without further ado, please allow me to officially welcome you, our new avid adventurer, into the Guild!

choices.text: They have a handbook for that now!?

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: A new member coming aboard is a momentous occasion! A little ceremony is only fair.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: It has a record of available commissions and rewards.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: And it is also proof of your membership.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Sometimes, you will find yourself stuck at a certain Adventure Rank.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: When this happens, you need to perform some impressive feats to gain further recognition from the Guild.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Impressive feats? Sounds like hazing to me.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: They are simply specific adventures that allow you to ascend to the next Adventure Rank on completion. Ascension adventures, if you will.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: But that will come later. Opportunities to win recognition will come as you gain more adventure experience.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: That will do for today. We will have plenty of chances to meet again in the future.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Ad astra abyssosque, Adventurer! With effort, you shall reach the stars and conquer the abyss!

choices.text: This looks more like a marketing pamphlet...

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: It is, in a way. But it has some practical uses too.

talks.objective: Talk to Katheryne for more details
